name: SmartBid
summary: A GC-side bid management tool, owned by ConstructConnect, for managing the sub database, prequalification, invitations and bid comparison.
differentiator: Subs invited to bid or prequalify pay nothing; the GC pays an annual license that scales with users. The standard license includes the sub database, prequalification, unlimited online plan-room projects and the BidTabs comparison tool, with Procore and Autodesk BIM 360 integrations. Faxing to subs is available at 8 cents a page, and on-site training costs extra.
pricing: Not published. SmartBid says licenses are annual and scale with the number of users. Faxing is 8 cents per page and on-site training costs extra.
whoPays: GC pays per user per year; invited subs free
bestFor: GCs that want invitations, prequalification and bid leveling in one license with a Procore or Autodesk link.
skipIf: You are a sub looking for leads. This tool does not find work.
